History[34]: MOUSE(row=45, col=1) - block 4, strip 20→24
History[35]: MOUSE(row=17, col=1) - block 1, strip 24 (no change)
So the pattern is:
- Block 4 (row 45) shifts strip right by 4
- Block 3 (row 37) shifts strip left by 4
- Block 4 can shift right up to a certain limit, then it stops working
- The limit seems to increase over time: first 20, then 24
Wait, looking more carefully:
- Histories 14-16: 3 clicks of block 4 moved strip from 8 to 20 (3 × 4 = 12 columns)
- History 17-19: block 4 stopped working (strip stayed at 20)
- History 21: block 3 moved strip from 20 to 16
- History 22: block 4 moved strip from 16 to 20
- Histories 23-27: block 4 stopped working again (strip stayed at 20)
- History 29: block 3 moved strip from 20 to 16
- History 30: block 4 moved strip from 16 to 20
- History 31: block 4 moved strip from 20 to 24 (this is the key!)
- History 32: block 4 stopped working (strip stayed at 24)
- History 33: block 3 moved strip from 24 to 20
- History 34: block 4 moved strip from 20 to 24
So the pattern is:
1. Click block 4 until it stops (reaches limit)
2. Click block 3 once to move left
3. Click block 4 once to move right (back to limit)
4. Click block 4 again - it now moves right by 4 (extends the limit!)
5. Repeat steps 2-4 to extend the limit further
This is like a "breakthrough" mechanic. Each time you reach the limit, go back one step, then push forward again to break through to the next position.
So to get from 24 to 28:
1. Click block 3 to move from 24 to 20
2. Click block 4 to move from 20 to 24
3. Click block 4 to move from 24 to 28 (breakthrough!)
Let me try this sequence!
